Container.Name: CNGI-WebPortal
Container.Overview: Public website and secure portal entry point for Robert Clemons A/C and Clemons NextGen Integrations.

Config.Name: Service Request URL
Config.Description: Core-backed service request destination. Leave blank until configured.

Config.Name: Public Base URL
Config.Description: Canonical public URL used for the Authentik OIDC callback.

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: Long random secret used to sign WebPortal sessions.

Config.Name: Authentik Base URL
Config.Description: Public HTTPS base URL for Authentik.

Config.Name: Authentik Client ID
Config.Description: OIDC client ID for the cngi-webportal Authentik provider.

Config.Name: Authentik Client Secret
Config.Description: OIDC client secret for the cngi-webportal Authentik provider.

Config.Name: CNGI Time URL
Config.Description: Public employee URL for CNGI Time.

Config.Name: CNGI Core URL
Config.Description: Public employee URL for CNGI Core.

Config.Name: LiteLLM URL
Config.Description: Employee URL for LiteLLM. Leave blank to hide the service.

Config.Name: Open WebUI URL
Config.Description: Employee URL for Open WebUI. Leave blank to hide the service.
